website.note: Pipeline shown only as 'Acne Kit — In Development' (image-based, no asset detail).

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: In September 2025, following completion of the Phase 3 STAR-1 trial of XYNGARI (DMT310) for moderate-to-severe acne, Dermata announced a strategic pivot away from prescription (Rx) drug development to direct-to-consumer cosmetic and OTC skincare products. The company no longer has an active P1/P2/P3 clinical pipeline; all historical ctgov studies (DMT310 and DMT210 across acne vulgaris, rosacea, atopic dermatitis) are COMPLETED or UNKNOWN status, with no ongoing or planned new prescription trials.
